name: Four Vows and a Raccoon
summary: Four weddings, in order, and a raccoon who was not invited to any of them and attended all four. Maddy and Cora open the arc; Harley finally asks a question she has been holding since Arc 7; Violet and Nova marry like the sporting wives they are; and Izzy and Fiona — already married, already wives before paper — are given a Found Family ceremony to honour them properly.
events: Maddy and Cora are married — the primary beat, and the arc opens on it
Harley and Yvaine are married. Harley had been holding the question since Arc 7
Izzy and Fiona's official Found Family ceremony — a second wedding for a marriage that already existed
Sir Trashmuffin, uninvited, four for four
Specter Haven's first wave — ten girls, five couples, into a house one arc old
SAGE PROVIDES THE FLORAL ARRANGEMENTS FOR ALL FOUR WEDDINGS
MULTIPLE BACHELOR AND BACHELORETTE PARTIES. Chaos level: maximum
Sage experiencing the Found Family at their most joyous
SIR TRASHMUFFIN EXHAUSTED FROM FOUR RING-BEARER DUTIES
LIVI OFFICIATES ALL FOUR, as always
EDEN AND DIA ATTEND AS GUESTS — the twice-yearly visits are established and they are integrated now
THEMES: joy multiplied · community celebration · friends becoming deeper family · love in all forms
RULED 7 SEPTEMBER: the four are Maddy × Cora, Harley × Yvaine, VIOLET × NOVA, and Izzy × Fiona. Livi and Rae marry in ARC 10, once
